Put your foot on the gas and floor it. Welcome to Rush, a new fast-paced 3v3 queued mode for CS2. Experience the push and pull as you advance through a gauntlet of randomly-selected battle arenas, and dominate your opponent to win the match!

Make the most of your limited budget and precious time to clear the objective. Control the tower when you eliminate the enemy team (or time expires) to win the round.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/4ccfe4f44119ac6ddd5cd39d24c907dd11f4c70a.png[/img]
Run the gauntlet of battle arenas to capture the enemy castle and win the match. The battle arenas are randomly selected each time you play, so no two matches are the same.

Keep track of your wins and compete for bragging rights with the Rush friends leaderboard!

[h3]Pick, Pick Pick, Pick[/h3]
[video webm="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/332c9f95f6e825649d2db55d15bff8a7d7c7b82a.webm" mp4="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/a26282d4460f972b036a9873a3f1ed5a98fe989a.mp4" poster="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/ab74e99b6fa25b35a355bc110a65e81906b3b22f.png" autoplay="true" controls="false"][/video]
We think that if you spend a lot of time developing strategies on a map, you should have a chance to benefit from that investment. So today we're changing the process for getting into a map in Premier--instead of banning down to a single map, teams will vote to pick two maps each. After all four maps are picked, a single map will be randomly selected and the match will begin.

[h3]Change You Can See[/h3]
[video webm="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/5341ed2d42a633c39e6aedb7342f26f3db78a418.webm" mp4="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/6f5bc36b20be7f069115b6bb1ea22e75ed4734e4.mp4" poster="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/924591876f9ac3a56b658770ca6945b6fa9096c7.png" autoplay="true" controls="false"][/video]
Today's update also includes several quality of life improvements, starting with blood and bullet impact visiblity. Blood is now much more bloody, and bullet impacts are far more impacty.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/22559f46380abfdad669fbbebfb02f50149fb1a2.png[/img]
But wait, there's more! Crosshairs have gotten a significant upgrade with new shapes and other features, so check out the new Crosshair/Scopes settings and create the custom crosshair of your dreams. Also, Clan Tags are back! Select one of your Steam Groups in your player profile and you'll see your clan tag appear next to your name wherever you play.

[h3]Change You Can't See (or Hear)[/h3]
There are some gameplay adjustments in today's update to add a bit of stealth to your game-time decisions. Reloading can now be performed silently (by holding the reload key), but with a cost--silent reloads take quite a bit longer. And for those of you who love scoping your scoped weapons, you'll now be perfectly silent when you unscope, as nature intended.

[h3]Starjunk 95[/h3]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/602718694f8ef8a7d4adce9f2db208286af6b37f.png[/img]
There's a new Music Kit in town, featuring the sounds of Starjunk 95. Experience music from the grooviest station in the galaxy, available now!

[h2]FAQ[/h2]

[h5]Q. Why aren't you selling capsules?[/h5]
In the past we shipped team and player autograph stickers in capsules. While this approach was popular, we've heard feedback that players might prefer to purchase stickers directly. Additionally, players in certain regions cannot purchase sticker capsules. So we're exploring alternatives that allow all players to participate.

[h5]Q. How do I get tournament items?[/h5]
Add any sticker or stickers you like to your cart, and check out. To complete your transaction, first you'll purchase and activate tokens, and then redeem those tokens for your sticker.

Sticker purchases are final and cannot be refunded. If you cancel your transaction before activating your tokens, those tokens _can_ be refunded. If you cancel your transaction after activating your tokens, the tokens will remain in your balance (and cannot be refunded) but you can redeem them for something else.

[h5]Q. How are sticker prices set?[/h5]
The prices of all stickers depend on relative demand. This means that if one sticker is purchased disproportionately more than another, its price will go up and the other sticker's price will go down. After a large number of stickers are sold, all sticker prices will update (you'll get a warning if you're shopping when this is about to happen). The prices in tokens you see are the same prices for everyone worldwide.

[h5]Q. Why do I have to purchase tokens?[/h5]
Tokens are a little less convenient than just paying for stickers outright. But the reality is that if stickers could be refunded after being purchased, then the sticker prices would not accurately represent real demand.

[h5]Q. Can I pre-purchase tokens?[/h5]
No. Tokens are only purchased when you're buying stickers and do not already have enough tokens in your balance. In that case, you'll be asked to purchase the exact number of tokens required (minimum 100, which is $0.99 USD) to complete your transaction.

[h5]Q. What if the sticker price goes down after I redeem my tokens?[/h5]
If the price of any redeemed sticker decreases by 25 tokens or more within the next 24 hours, we'll automatically issue you a refund of tokens for the difference between your redemption price and the lowest price in that period. Refunds are automatically credited to your tokens balance after one week.

[h5]Q. How do souvenirs work this time?[/h5]
Take any weapon of normal or souvenir quality in your inventory and select a completed match and one of the players from that match. You'll permanently convert that weapon into a Souvenir with gold team, autograph, and map stickers applied. You will have a chance to see a preview of your souvenir before you complete your purchase.

If the weapon had any existing stickers, they will be removed before you craft your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are souvenir prices determined?[/h5]
Souvenir prices are determined by two factors: the demand for the specific gold team and autograph stickers involved, and the rarity of the weapon you choose for your souvenir.

[h5]Q. How are royalties shared among the tournament organizer, teams and players?[/h5]
50% of total Major Shop and Major Pass revenue is shared as royalties with the tournament organizer, teams, and players. The chart below shows how that 50% is distributed. Note that for each team position, half of the royalties are shared with the team organization, and the other half is split equally among the five players.

Between now and the grand final, royalties are shared based on the teams' global VRS leading into the event. After the grand final, royalties will be shared based on the final standings.

[p]From reloading to custom games, today's update will give you plenty to think about.
[/p][h3]Reload[/h3][p][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/5dd914dd4a8901aa52b0075f683a6d0e3538d55b.png[/img]
When you reload in CS2, the leftover ammo in your magazine is dumped back into an essentially endless reserve supply. And so the decision to reload has never offered significant trade-offs—in a safe position with enough time, you might reload after firing a single bullet, or half a mag, or after firing down to empty, and the rest of the round would be unaffected. 

We think the decision to reload should have higher stakes, so in today's update reloading has been redesigned. Now, when you reload, you'll drop the used magazine and discard all of its remaining ammo. Instead of 'topping off' your weapon with a few bullets, a new full magazine will be taken from the reserves whenever you reload. 

How many reserve mags will each weapon have? Most have gotten a three clips fill-up, but some weapons will have less to reward efficiency and precision, or more to encourage spamming through walls and smokes. Keep an eye on your reserve supply!

[/p][h3]Map Guides in Competitive Matches[/h3][p]
We get it. You [i]could[/i] learn some smokes offline, but who has the time? 

To help you pick up some new tricks, map guides can now be used during the first five rounds of the half in your competitive matches. Competitive map guides are more limited than the ones you use offline, but should be enough to give you a few reminders.

You can activate a guide in the pause menu, and to get you started there are official map guides available for Active Duty maps. But if you're looking for something more specific, you can subscribe to guides on the Steam Community Workshop.

[/p][h3]Join Friends in Custom Games[/h3][p][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/3381077/12cbcda636bfce8e15f9df254d0725feb0261abe.png[/img]
Over the past several months, the CS community has been hard at work building custom game modes using special scripting tools. Now, you can join your friends in the fun!

Whenever you're playing a custom game, whether on a community server or hosted locally, your friends will be able to join you directly from the Friends list (as long as the server allows it). 

Want to set up your own custom game? Head over to your Workshop Maps tab in the Play menu, and make sure to turn on "Open Party." Now, when you start playing your workshop map you'll host a game on your machine, and your friends will be able to join.

So head to the Steam Community Workshop, subscribe to some maps, and try something new![/p]
